GROK 4.5 LEADS VULCANBENCH’S NEW CODING BENCHMARK

Grok 4.5 just took the top spot on VulcanBench, a new coding benchmark focused on real-world software tasks.
It scored 91.3%, successfully solving 21 out of 23 practical coding challenges across five languages — outperforming Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol.
On top of the strong performance, Grok 4.5 continues to dominate the cost-efficiency frontier, delivering top results at a fraction of the cost of competing frontier models.
This latest win reinforces Grok 4.5’s strength in practical, production-ready coding — not just synthetic benchmarks.

@elonmusk

BREAKING: Zimbabwe is expanding digital education with Starlink in rural schools. 🇿🇼

• Swereki Secondary School and Jalukanga Primary School have received Starlink internet, new science laboratories, and improved water infrastructure.
• Students say reliable internet will help them conduct research, strengthen their studies, and access better learning resources.
• Government officials say more rural schools will receive Starlink as part of a nationwide effort to expand digital education.
• The initiative supports Zimbabwe's Heritage-Based Education 5.0 curriculum by bringing modern technology to underserved communities.

Source: ZBC NEWS

BREAKING: Starlink has begun assigning local Iraqi IP addresses to users in Iraq. 🇮🇶

• The update follows Starlink's recent approval to operate in the country.
• Previously, Iraqi users were routed through Europe using Bulgarian IP addresses.
• Local IP routing is expected to reduce latency and improve overall network performance.

Another step as Starlink continues expanding and localizing its global network.

Yes. The liner truck uses a model 3 battery back (or two batteries depending on the liner truck model) and a slightly modified model 3 rear drive unit. We just take the differential out and replace it with a spline but other than that it’s basically stock. 

The drive unit acts as the primary mover for a hydraulic pump that creates the fluid power needed to rotate the trucks 4x hydraulic motors.

BREAKING: Tesla secured the top two best-selling vehicles in the UK last month. 🇬🇧

• Model Y finished as the country's No. 1 best-selling car.
• Model 3 followed in second place.
• Tesla delivered 12,173 vehicles across the UK.
• The company accounted for 5.7% of all new car registrations.

It wasn't just an EV victory—Tesla led the entire UK automotive market.

Starlink is reshaping in-flight Wi-Fi across the aviation industry. 

The biggest U.S. airlines are continuing to move toward Starlink-powered connectivity:

• United: already live and expanding
• Southwest: rollout starts this summer
• Alaska: regional fleet complete, mainline rollout underway
• Hawaiian: live across its long-haul fleet
• American: 500+ aircraft beginning in early 2027
• Frontier: first Starlink-equipped aircraft expected in early 2027

Worldwide, more than 45 airlines have either deployed Starlink, started installations, or announced plans to adopt it.

Reliable, low-latency internet is rapidly becoming an expected part of flying, and Starlink is leading that transition.

BREAKING: Tesla is leading Germany's new EV subsidy program. 🇩🇪

• Tesla ranks #1 among all individual brands for subsidy approvals.
• Holds a 74% lead over second-place Škoda.
• Trails Stellantis by just 192 approvals, despite Stellantis combining seven brands.
• Q2 registrations reached 16,028, more than four times higher year over year.
• June registrations surged 318% to 7,768.
• First-half registrations climbed to 28,857, up 225%.
• Model Y was Germany's best-selling EV in June.

Another strong quarter as Tesla continues gaining momentum in Europe's largest automotive market.
